name: Deadly Stab
body:
Deadly Stab (Ex)
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 59
At 19th level, when the swashbuckler conf irms a critical hit with a light or one-handed piercing melee weapon, in addition to the normal damage, she can spend 1 panache point to inf lict a deadly stab. The target must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or die. The DC of this save is 10 + 1/2 the swashbuckler’s level + the swashbuckler’s Dexterity modif ier. This is a death attack. Performing this deed does not grant the swashbuckler a panache point.
